description: the same caching profile on a share carrying SMB2_SHAREFLAG_FORCE_LEVELII_OPLOCK, where every grant caps to a read cache. Generated but NOT driven -- run_samba_mbt.sh configures smbd with oplocks off, and smb2_replay.py skips any trace whose profile turns a caching capability on, so this cell reports a ctest SKIP. Registered anyway so the gap stays visible and attributable to the harness rather than hidden by not generating the traces.
